# Asteroid Escape

A top‑down HTML canvas game where the player pilots a small ship that can thrust in any direction to dodge an endless stream of randomly moving asteroids. Fuel pickups appear occasionally; the ship’s fuel depletes over time. **Lose condition:** collision with an asteroid or running out of fuel.

1: // Simple Asteroid Escape game
2: // Canvas with id "game" must exist in the HTML.
3: // Controls: ←/→ rotate, ↑ thrust, space for manual fuel boost (optional).
4: 
5: (() => {
6:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
7:   if (!canvas) {
8:     console.error('Canvas element with id "game" not found');
9:     return;
10:   }
11:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
12:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
13:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
14:   // initialize star field
15:   initStars();
16: 
17:   // --- Game constants ---
18:   const SHIP_SIZE = 15; // radius for drawing
19:   const SHIP_THRUST = 0.1;
20:   const SHIP_TURN_SPEED = 0.06; // radians per frame
21:   const FUEL_DEPLETION = 0.02; // per frame
22:   const FUEL_PICKUP_AMOUNT = 30;
23:   const ASTEROID_MIN_SPEED = 0.5;
24:   const ASTEROID_MAX_SPEED = 2.5;
25:   const ASTEROID_SPAWN_INTERVAL = 2000; // ms
26:   const FUEL_SPAWN_INTERVAL = 8000; // ms
27:   // star field configuration
28:   const STAR_COUNT = 100;
29:   const stars = [];
30: 
31:   // --- Sound setup ---
32:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
33:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
34:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
35:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
36:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
37:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
38:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
39:     osc.start();
40:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
41:   }
42:   // thrust continuous tone
43:   let thrustOsc = null;
44:   function startThrustSound() {
45:     if (thrustOsc) return;
46:     thrustOsc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
47:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
48:     thrustOsc.frequency.value = 150;
49:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.05, audioCtx.currentTime);
50:     thrustOsc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
51:     thrustOsc.start();
52:   }
53:   function stopThrustSound() {
54:     if (!thrustOsc) return;
55:     thrustOsc.stop();
56:     thrustOsc.disconnect();
57:     thrustOsc = null;
58:   }
59:   function playExplosion() {
60:     playTone(80, 0.4);
61:   }
62:   function playPickup() {
63:     playTone(600, 0.1);
64:   }
65: 
66:   // --- Game state ---
67:   const ship = {
68:     x: width / 2,
69:     y: height / 2,
70:     vx: 0,
71:     vy: 0,
72:     angle: -Math.PI / 2,
73:     fuel: 100,
74:     thrusting: false,
75:     turningLeft: false,
76:     turningRight: false,
77:   };
78: 
79:   const asteroids = [];
80:   const fuels = [];
81:   let lastAsteroidSpawn = 0;
82:   let lastFuelSpawn = 0;
83:   let gameOver = false;
84: 
85:   // --- Input handling ---
86:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
87:     // Resume audio context on first interaction
88:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
89:     switch (e.code) {
90:       case 'ArrowUp':
91:         ship.thrusting = true;
92:         startThrustSound();
93:         break;
94:       case 'ArrowLeft':
95:         ship.turningLeft = true;
96:         break;
97:       case 'ArrowRight':
98:         ship.turningRight = true;
99:         break;
100:     }
101:   });
102:   window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
103:     switch (e.code) {
104:       case 'ArrowUp':
105:         ship.thrusting = false;
106:         stopThrustSound();
107:         break;
108:       case 'ArrowLeft':
109:         ship.turningLeft = false;
110:         break;
111:       case 'ArrowRight':
112:         ship.turningRight = false;
113:         break;
114:     }
115:   });
116: 
117:   // --- Helper functions ---
118:   function spawnAsteroid() {
119:     // Spawn at random edge
120:     const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
121:     let x, y, vx, vy;
122:     const radius = 10 + Math.random() * 20;
123:     const speed = ASTEROID_MIN_SPEED + Math.random() * (ASTEROID_MAX_SPEED - ASTEROID_MIN_SPEED);
124:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
125:     vx = Math.cos(angle) * speed;
126:     vy = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
127:     switch (edge) {
128:       case 0: // top
129:         x = Math.random() * width;
130:         y = -radius;
131:         break;
132:       case 1: // right
133:         x = width + radius;
134:         y = Math.random() * height;
135:         break;
136:       case 2: // bottom
137:         x = Math.random() * width;
138:         y = height + radius;
139:         break;
140:       case 3: // left
141:         x = -radius;
142:         y = Math.random() * height;
143:         break;
144:     }
145:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, radius });
146:   }
147: 
148:   function spawnFuel() {
149:     const radius = 8;
150:     const x = radius + Math.random() * (width - 2 * radius);
151:     const y = radius + Math.random() * (height - 2 * radius);
152:     fuels.push({ x, y, radius });
153:   }
154: 
155:   // Initialize star field positions
156:   function initStars() {
157:     for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
158:       stars.push({
159:         x: Math.random() * width,
160:         y: Math.random() * height,
161:       });
162:     }
163:   }
164: 
165:   function distance(ax, ay, bx, by) {
166:     const dx = ax - bx;
167:     const dy = ay - by;
168:     return Math.hypot(dx, dy);
169:   }
170: 
171:   function drawShip() {
172:     ctx.save();
173:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
174:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
175:     // ship body
176:     ctx.beginPath();
177:     ctx.moveTo(SHIP_SIZE, 0);
178:     ctx.lineTo(-SHIP_SIZE * 0.6, SHIP_SIZE * 0.8);
179:     ctx.lineTo(-SHIP_SIZE * 0.6, -SHIP_SIZE * 0.8);
180:     ctx.closePath();
181:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
182:     ctx.fill();
183:     // thrust flame
184:     if (ship.thrusting && ship.fuel > 0) {
185:       ctx.beginPath();
186:       ctx.moveTo(-SHIP_SIZE * 0.6, SHIP_SIZE * 0.4);
187:       ctx.lineTo(-SHIP_SIZE * 1.2, 0);
188:       ctx.lineTo(-SHIP_SIZE * 0.6, -SHIP_SIZE * 0.4);
189:       ctx.closePath();
190:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
191:       ctx.fill();
192:     }
193:     ctx.restore();
194:   }
195: 
196:   function drawAsteroid(a) {
197:     const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.radius * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.radius);
198:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#b0b0b0');
199:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#404040');
200:     ctx.beginPath();
201:     ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
202:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
203:     ctx.fill();
204:   }
205: 
206:   function drawFuel(f) {
207:     ctx.beginPath();
208:     ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
209:     ctx.fillStyle = 'lime';
210:     ctx.fill();
211:   }
212: 
213:   function drawFuelBar() {
214:     const barWidth = 100;
215:     const barHeight = 8;
216:     const x = 10;
217:     const y = 10;
218:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
219:     ctx.fillRect(x - 1, y - 1, barWidth + 2, barHeight + 2);
220:     ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
221:     const fuelRatio = Math.max(0, ship.fuel) / 100;
222:     ctx.fillRect(x, y, barWidth * fuelRatio, barHeight);
223:   }
224: 
225:   function update(dt) {
226:     // Turn ship
227:     if (ship.turningLeft) ship.angle -= SHIP_TURN_SPEED;
228:     if (ship.turningRight) ship.angle += SHIP_TURN_SPEED;
229: 
230:     // Thrust
231:     if (ship.thrusting && ship.fuel > 0) {
232:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * SHIP_THRUST;
233:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * SHIP_THRUST;
234:       ship.fuel -= FUEL_DEPLETION; // fuel used while thrusting
235:     } else {
236:       // passive fuel consumption
237:       ship.fuel -= FUEL_DEPLETION * 0.2;
238:     }
239: 
240:     // Move ship
241:     ship.x += ship.vx;
242:     ship.y += ship.vy;
243: 
244:     // Screen wrap for ship
245:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += width;
246:     if (ship.x > width) ship.x -= width;
247:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y += height;
248:     if (ship.y > height) ship.y -= height;
249: 
250:     // Update asteroids
251:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
252:       const a = asteroids[i];
253:       a.x += a.vx;
254:       a.y += a.vy;
255:       // wrap
256:       if (a.x < -a.radius) a.x += width + a.radius * 2;
257:       if (a.x > width + a.radius) a.x -= width + a.radius * 2;
258:       if (a.y < -a.radius) a.y += height + a.radius * 2;
259:       if (a.y > height + a.radius) a.y -= height + a.radius * 2;
260:       // collision with ship
261:       if (distance(ship.x, ship.y, a.x, a.y) < SHIP_SIZE + a.radius) {
262:         gameOver = true;
263:         playExplosion();
264:         break;
265:       }
266:     }
267: 
268:     // Check fuel pickups
269:     for (let i = fuels.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
270:       const f = fuels[i];
271: if (distance(ship.x, ship.y, f.x, f.y) < SHIP_SIZE + f.radius) {
272:           ship.fuel = Math.min(100, ship.fuel + FUEL_PICKUP_AMOUNT);
273:           fuels.splice(i, 1);
274:           playPickup();
275:         }
276:     }
277: 
278:     // Lose if out of fuel
279:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
280: 
281:     // Spawn new asteroids / fuel based on timers
282:     const now = performance.now();
283:     if (now - lastAsteroidSpawn > ASTEROID_SPAWN_INTERVAL) {
284:       spawnAsteroid();
285:       lastAsteroidSpawn = now;
286:     }
287:     if (now - lastFuelSpawn > FUEL_SPAWN_INTERVAL) {
288:       spawnFuel();
289:       lastFuelSpawn = now;
290:     }
291:   }
292: 
293:   function render() {
294:     // Draw space background with gradient and stars
295:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
296:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#02010a');
297:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#090c1f');
298:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
299:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
300:     // stars
301:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
302:     for (let s of stars) {
303:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, 1, 1);
304:     }
305:     drawShip();
306:     asteroids.forEach(drawAsteroid);
307:     fuels.forEach(drawFuel);
308:     drawFuelBar();
309:   }
310: 
311:   function loop(timestamp) {
312:     if (gameOver) {
313:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
314:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
315:       ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
316:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
317:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
318:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
319:       return;
320:     }
321:     update(timestamp);
322:     render();
323:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
324:   }
325: 
326:   // Initialise first spawn timers
327:   lastAsteroidSpawn = performance.now();
328:   lastFuelSpawn = performance.now();
329:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
330: })();

(End of file - total 330 lines)
</content>
